description: Connect your ReiFax account to search authorized property data, count investment opportunities, retrieve property details and comparable sales, and calculate deal scores. Explore building analytics, cash buyers and Florida corporation records. Review Follow Up properties, tasks, history, offers, KPIs and email messages. On request, supported tools can add properties to Follow Up, update contacts, save an initial offer and queue skip tracing. The plugin does not send emails, purchase properties or transfer funds.
